_about: Reusable DANCE QUALITIES — the adjectives of movement. Attach them to figures, sequences, musicality ideas, and concepts via their `dance_qualities` or `related_items`. A quality answers 'how is it danced', not 'what is danced'. id convention: qual-<slug>. ALL fields optional — a one-line entry is a valid entry; the collaborator fills cues/risks only when it actually knows them.
_id_convention: qual-<slug>  (e.g. qual-legato). Reference from other DBs by this id.

_template.description: What this quality feels like / means in one or two lines.
_template.physical_cues: Body cues that produce it (axis, knees, embrace, timing of the weight change).
_template.musical_cues: What in the music invites it (legato strings, marcato beat, a pause, a build).
_template.risks: Where it goes wrong / what it costs (readability, floor space, monotony).

qualities.name: Big
qualities.description: Large amplitude — long steps, full pivots, the dance fills space.
qualities.physical_cues: Project further; commit the axis fully into each step; open the embrace if needed.
qualities.musical_cues: Wide legato phrases, dramatic orchestras (Pugliese), section climaxes.
qualities.risks: Eats floor; unsafe in a crowded ronda; tiring if used constantly.

qualities.name: Small / compact
qualities.description: Minimal amplitude — short steps, contained pivots, dancing 'inside a phone booth'.
qualities.physical_cues: Tiny weight changes, free foot stays close, no big projections.
qualities.musical_cues: Crowded floor, intimate passages, fast rhythmic sections where big won't fit.
qualities.risks: Can read as timid or monotonous if quality never varies.

qualities.name: Legato
qualities.description: Connected, continuous, no visible seams between movements — one long breath.
qualities.physical_cues: Slow the weight transfer; never stop fully; let one movement melt into the next.
qualities.musical_cues: Sustained strings, bowed lines, Di Sarli, the 'singing' parts.
qualities.risks: Loses definition if there's no contrast; can blur the beat.

qualities.name: Staccato
qualities.description: Sharp, detached, clearly articulated — each step a distinct event.
qualities.physical_cues: Fast, decisive weight change ('light switch'); clean arrivals; hold the shape briefly.
qualities.musical_cues: Marcato beat, D'Arienzo drive, piano/bandoneon accents.
qualities.risks: Relentless staccato becomes choppy/military; needs legato to breathe against.

qualities.name: Playful
qualities.description: Witty, surprising, light — teasing the music, little jokes with timing.
qualities.physical_cues: Syncopations, traspiés, quick changes of mind, suspensions and 'gotchas'.
qualities.musical_cues: Bouncy rhythmic tangos and milonga; call-and-response phrases.
qualities.risks: Reads as restless or unclear if the lead isn't crisp; tiring for the follower if constant.

qualities.name: Spectacular
qualities.description: Made to be watched — large, impressive, 'wow' shapes.
qualities.physical_cues: Boleos, big sweeping turns, height/extension, dynamic contrast.
qualities.musical_cues: Climaxes, the final phrase of a song, dramatic orchestras.
qualities.risks: Floor-unsafe; can prioritise looks over the follower's comfort. Show/practica, rarely social.

qualities.name: Intimate
qualities.description: Inward, close, for the two of you — not for an audience.
qualities.physical_cues: Close embrace, small vocabulary, shared breath, subtle weight shifts.
qualities.musical_cues: Tender vocal passages, quiet sections, slow tangos.
qualities.risks: Can feel flat if never contrasted with energy.

qualities.name: Compact
qualities.description: Efficient and tight — small footprint but still full of intention.
qualities.physical_cues: Economy of movement; everything close to the axis; no wasted travel.

qualities.name: Dramatic
qualities.description: High emotional stakes — tension, weight, intensity.
qualities.physical_cues: Deep into the floor, strong dissociation, pauses loaded with energy.
qualities.musical_cues: Pugliese, big builds and releases, minor-key swells.
qualities.risks: Wears thin if everything is dramatic — drama needs calm to land.

qualities.name: Elastic
qualities.description: Stretch-and-release — energy stored and returned, like a rubber band.
qualities.physical_cues: Load the dissociation/free leg, then let the rebound do the work (the boleo mechanic).
qualities.musical_cues: Phrases with a clear tension/resolution shape.

qualities.name: Grounded
qualities.description: Heavy, rooted, connected to the floor — weight clearly in the earth.
qualities.physical_cues: Bend into the standing leg, push the floor away, slow controlled descents.
qualities.musical_cues: Strong bass/marcato, walking sections, milonguero feel.

qualities.name: Suspended
qualities.description: Held in the air, time stretched — a loaded pause before release.
qualities.physical_cues: Arrive and wait on the axis; keep tension alive; release on a musical cue.
qualities.musical_cues: Pauses, fermatas, the silence before a phrase restarts.
qualities.risks: Dead air if the suspension has no energy in it — suspense, not a stop.

qualities.name: Delicate
qualities.description: Light, fine, precise handling — a careful, tender touch. Not the same as legato (continuity) or suspended (held); it's about the FINENESS of the handling.
qualities.physical_cues: Light embrace pressure, precise axis, small careful weight shifts; give her room to be exact.
qualities.musical_cues: Tender vocal lines, soft romantic passages, quiet sections.
qualities.risks: Can tip into tentative/under-led if the clarity drops — delicate must still be clear.
qualities.examples: The calesita; featuring her embellishments in a slow romantic part.

qualities.name: Simple
qualities.description: Plain and clear — walking, basic vocabulary, nothing to prove.
qualities.physical_cues: Clean walk, complete weight changes, comfortable embrace.
qualities.musical_cues: Almost anything — simplicity danced with quality is never boring.
